item.summary: President Donald Trump announced "major combat operations" against Iran on Feb. 28, with massive joint U.S.-Israeli strikes.

item.title: WATCH: Secretary Pete Hegseth provides update on war with Iran at Pentagon briefing
item.summary: Iran fired the "lowest number of enemy missiles and drones" in the last 24 hours, Secretary Pete Hegseth said at a Pentagon press briefing Tuesday

item.title: WATCH: Michigan synagogue attacker committed 'Hezbollah-inspired act of terrorism': FBI
item.summary: The man armed with fireworks who rammed his truck into a Michigan synagogue was carrying out " a Hezbollah-inspired act of terrorism purposely targeting the Jewish community," the FBI said Monday.

item.summary: Firefighters said a woman and man were thrown from the boat and run over, killing the woman.

item.title: Supreme Court rules against Colorado law banning 'conversion therapy' for minors
item.summary: The Supreme Court struck down Colorado's ban on so-called "conversion therapy" for minors as a violation of counselors' free speech rights under the First Amendment.

item.title: Florida Gov. DeSantis signs bill to rename Palm Beach airport after Trump
item.summary: Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis signed a bill Monday renaming Palm Beach International Airport to the President Donald J. Trump International Airport.

item.title: WATCH: Business owner hit with mystery shipment of 600 French onion dips
item.summary: ABC News' Danny New reports on the unexpectedly robust shipment of French onion dip that landed on a Philadelphia business owner after asking for a sample.

item.title: WATCH: Delta flight makes emergency landing after engine fire
